function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT sku,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-08' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS aug_qty,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-09' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS sep_qty,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-09' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period='2026-08' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS qty_change
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line
WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY sku
ORDER BY qty_change DESC
LIMIT 10","purpose":"Top SKUs by quantity change between Aug and Sep 2026"}
